source: platform/ra8p1/fixture_app.cpp execute()/status_command() plus k1_status_led.c and palette_runtime.cpp

framing.request_layout: magic u32op u32req u32seq u32size u32payload_crc u32proto=1 | u32header_crc | payload
framing.response_layout: magic u32status u32req_echo u32trajectory_sequence u32size u32cycles u32payload_crc u32header_crc | payload
framing.integrity: zlib/IEEE CRC32 of payload at header+20; CRC32 of first 28 header bytes at +28; host and device both check. Header CRC is not DSP hop CRC.
framing.implementation: scripts/run_led_smoke.py packet()/read_exact(); broker imports those functions

operations.name: INFO identity
operations.side_effects: none besides filling the reply buffer
operations.ss03: REQUIRED first after ownership; cache; never periodic

operations.name: platform metrics JSON
operations.response: stack/heap/fpscr plus pdm_target measured_hz, ap_hops, overflows, last_hop_peak, lane metrics when PDM compiled
operations.side_effects: On K1_PDM_TARGET: k1_pdm_target_poll and k1_ws281x_gpt_dma_hw_poll (service existing workload, no 100 ms stall). Without PDM: rt_thread_mdelay(100).
operations.cost: compact JSON; historical late-starts were opcode 8 not 6
operations.ss03: CANDIDATE compact poll after identity if the image answers it

operations.name: schedule status
operations.response: large JSON with histograms; G4 USB_STATUS_READ_COMPLETE late starts
operations.ss03: FORBIDDEN periodic and do not start the matching workload

operations.name: WS2816 packed-lane smoke
operations.side_effects: six blinks, ~1 s IRQ hold; status 10 when K1_PALETTE_GPT_DMA

operations.name: palette catalogue or PCM1808 metrics
operations.ss03: not used; catalogue is not health

operations.name: palette status
operations.response: compact JSON frames/emitted/emit_errors/last_emit_cycles/frame CRCs; photons NOT claimed
operations.ss03: CANDIDATE compact poll staggered with opcode 6

operations.name: palette frame bytes
operations.side_effects: returns current pixels; music baseline used this at 8 Hz and froze emit under dense USB

operations.name: status LED / LED2 PHY
operations.request: size 0 = snapshot (slim if schedule active). sub 1 identify, 2 ack, 3 ack-recovery, 4 wait, 5 wait-clear, 6 verdict, 7 bind/test_begin, 8 LED2 experiment, 9 LED2 binary trace
operations.side_effects: empty is read; every other subcommand changes LED/PHY/test state
operations.ss03: empty snapshot only if used; never the whole opcode. Default campaign does not poll 20.

ss03_admitted.aggregate: 1 transaction/s initial; max 5 compact/s only with counter support
